parameters.name: Operation
parameters.description: Unique: each vertex gets own point. Cusp: split at sharp angles. Consolidate: merge nearby points.

parameters.name: Angle
parameters.description: Threshold angle for cusp detection. Faces exceeding this angle get split edges.

parameters.name: Technique
parameters.description: Algorithm for consolidation. Spatial Grid is fastest for large point sets.

parameters.name: Remove Degenerate
parameters.description: Remove primitives where consecutive vertices reference the same point.

parameters.name: Remove Unused Points
parameters.description: Remove orphan points not referenced by any primitive.

Increase Distance parameter. Check Technique is appropriate for your point density.

description: Controls point sharing between primitives. Unique Points splits shared points, Consolidate Points merges nearby points, Cusp Polygons splits at sharp edges. Essential for controlling shading and geometry topology.
